notes.title: Update 2021.8.12 (1.01)
notes.content:
Update 2021.8.12 (1.01) has just been released! This coincides with the demo release, so check that out if you want to give the game a try. The update has the following features/fixes:

[list]
[*] Added damage effects to indicate when an enemy or player ship has been hit
[*] Added screen shake effects for the destruction of large ships, and when launching from a planet
[*] Updated minigun sprite with a spherical base, and added spin-up phase and sound
[*] Large increase to Robot Heavy enemy hull strength
[*] Fixed planet rotations only occurring clockwise
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Released
notes.content: The demo version of Super CosmoJet is now available, so you can try the game for free! Play through the tutorial and the first star system. Enjoy!

notes.title: Super CosmoJet Released!
notes.content:
It's here! Super CosmoJet is now available, and I'm excited to get any and all (constructive) feedback from players.

I'm planning on improving and updating the game going forward, but first thing on the agenda is a free demo version consisting of the tutorial and first level. So, if you're not sure about buying the game yet, that will give you the chance to try it first. Life is pretty busy at the moment, but I'll aim to have the demo ready in the next few weeks.

Hope you all enjoy the game!
